verdict.rationale: Angular documents its own public interfaces: a framework API suite and a CLI reference whose commands (generate/modify files via schematics, build, test, run Architect targets, get/set config) let an agent drive the product scriptably. However, the evidence shows no API reference depth and no programmatic, agent-oriented surface beyond the CLI. missing for 10: detailed public API reference evidence, a programmatic (non-CLI) interface for driving the tooling, independent corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Angular provides a broad suite of tools, APIs, and libraries
Generates and/or modifies files based on a schematic.
Runs an Architect target with an optional custom builder configuration defined in your project.
Retrieves or sets Angular configuration values in the angular.json file for the workspace.
